decision.reasoning_trace: I narrowed my search to reputable audio brands and well-reviewed budget alternatives. The Bose SoundLink Color II and JBL Charge 4 represent the premium end of the spectrum with high consumer trust. While the INSMY offered a great price-to-performance ratio, the renewed JBL Charge 4 provides the best overall value for sound quality and volume. I chose the JBL Charge 4 because its 4.7-star rating and reputation for 'loud' and 'great sound' outweigh the potential risks of it being a refurbished unit, especially at a price point under $100.
